method: Visual inspection of all five original-PTS instrument contact sheets, 47..55s at 0.25s spacing; no image enhancement or OCR.

coasting_observation.interpretation: Displayed gear remains3 while speed and tach decrease; this does not reveal actual pedal/load or injector state.

limits: Sampled display brackets, not actuator timestamps
Wheelspin/traction intervention may occur during launch
Mode/gear and acoustic-path differences may confound comparisons
No measured pedal/load or fuel supply
